description: This file contains the implementation of 'ImmutableJsonifiableAdaptable', a final class that provides an immutable, JSON-compatible view of an Adaptable object within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonifiableAdaptable
classes.description: An immutable class that wraps an Adaptable to provide JSON serialization and access to topic path, payload, and headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonifiableAdaptable by wrapping a given Adaptable object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an ImmutableJsonifiableAdaptable from a JsonObject, extracting headers, topic path, and payload.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the topic path associated with this adaptable.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload associated with this adaptable.

methods.name: containsHeaderForKey
methods.description: Checks if a header with the specified key exists.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the adaptable to a JsonObject including current headers and payload.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the adaptable to a JsonObject with specified headers.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the delegateAdaptable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the Ditto headers associated with the adaptable.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ImmutableJsonifiableAdaptable with updated Ditto headers.
